name: Headcase Kustom Art Studio
tagline: Your Story with Panicci Ventures — Video Testimonial
introHtml: Thanks for doing this — it means a lot. A few quick questions about our work together. Just talk naturally, 30–60 seconds each — and yes, the numbers in these questions are your real numbers.

questions.label: Intro
questions.text: Introduce yourself — your name, what Headcase Kustom Art Studio is, and the kind of work that comes out of your Las Vegas shop.

questions.label: Before
questions.text: Before Panicci Ventures, how did people find your work — and what was staying word-of-mouth-only costing you?

questions.label: Why Sammy
questions.text: Custom art is a visual business with a personal brand. Why trust Sammy and Panicci Ventures to build your online presence?

questions.label: What We Handle
questions.text: What does Panicci Ventures handle for you — the website, Google Business Profile, showing up when Vegas searches for custom art?

questions.label: The Numbers
questions.text: Real numbers: across the Las Vegas searches we track, you're already averaging a top-10 spot in the local map results. What's changed since your studio became findable?

questions.label: What's Working
questions.text: What's working best right now — and which result honestly surprised you the most?

questions.label: Working with Sammy
questions.text: How is working with Sammy different from other marketers — communication, speed, no lock-in contracts?

questions.label: Moment
questions.text: Is there a commission or a customer that came in straight from Google that sticks with you?

questions.label: Recommend
questions.text: What would you tell another artist or custom shop that's brilliant at the craft but invisible online?

questions.label: One-liner
questions.text: Finish this sentence: “Working with Sammy P is…”

editingBrief: PARTNER TESTIMONIAL for Panicci Ventures, spoken by the owner of Headcase Kustom Art Studio (Las Vegas). Goal: case-study proof for panicciventures.com and pitch decks. Produce a full-length cut plus one clip per segment. NUMBERS, MOMENT, and SAMMY are the hero clips; RECO and ONE are the ad closers. Trim dead air, burn in captions, keep the speaker centered, export per platformTargets.
